# Oportun to Present at Sidoti September Virtual Investor Conference


September 22, 2026 4:07pm EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_8b2ec02013bc2f4b179ab49bc99ca7cf/oportun/news/2026-09-22_Oportun_to_Present_at_Sidoti_September_Virtual_205.pdf)


SAN MATEO, Calif., Sept. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT), a mission-driven financial services company, today announced that it will participate in the upcoming Sidoti September Virtual Investor Conference.


Oportun’s Senior Vice President of Investor Relations, Dorian Hare, will present and participate in investor meetings at the conference. The presentation will begin at 2:30 pm ET on September 24th and can be accessed live at this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ScIQB5kBE3OHhQZSM68ZZqT1Wpys2Dl4xhnPpQm1f2radU5abI-GYdoXYdqoO9ccdS3hsY0xy0qkXUp2A3Y4jqiQI09HZklNNcX0mO4uzabAoXIj8lIQdJeD92pfinimXso6LyyrdQXU0zyY6FoVsA==) .


A link to the presentation webcast will also be accessible in the “IR calendar” section of Oportun’s Investor Relations website under “News & Events” at[https://investor.oportun.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sfOQpSWs6Syht6PeD7zQACemAuAuE2hBLv8za8RNrzJTMNUNfpxgJaC0ttQXbXnR9tiyrSC2MorPoHe4cHd9ozSgAVrhFdAECMym34wIfqE3QN5EfphfNn_dVIHOvSvYpPP-A20KITBkhGPkFyfG1V5YI_5WVeNRz6bs7awWnhD40RVsrf7T_UyCKKkWCqP0HJ229kepToj1y_hTUvAIRfA-e1zrRqB-sqEejR1uCQv_cRdj3ywsf_kE0baU8JSMmsRB-hmAyFlC-wCnTJWM1g==) . A replay will be available for an additional 90 days via the same link following the conference.


**About Oportun**
Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members’ financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. For more information, visit[Oportun.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ZZbuxR4RtiQ69iE7iwqxhm-CzgUp7A5Ca9hfL6Gd6PPEphn1sYC4vODxBZDW2SwH7t7Y0yatHo6LBBkIrVbeHA==) .
